# go-freno-client

A Go client for [Freno](https://github.com/github/freno) (Throttler Service)

## More Details

This [engineering post](https://github.com/orgs/github/teams/engineering/discussions/1045) is a good overview of what freno is all about, and how you could start using it in Go.
